verses.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.pt: Bendize, ó minha alma, ao Senhor! Senhor, Deus meu, tu és magnificentíssimo! Estás vestido de honra e de majestade,
verses.en_web: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great; you are robed with honour and power.

verses.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.pt: tu que te cobres de luz como de um manto, que estendes os céus como uma cortina.
verses.en_web: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.en_bbe: You are clothed with light as with a robe; stretching out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.pt: És tu que pões nas águas os vigamentos da tua morada, que fazes das nuvens o teu carro, que andas sobre as asas do vento;
verses.en_web: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
verses.en_bbe: The arch of your house is based on the waters; you make the clouds your carriage; you go on the wings of the wind:

verses.en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.pt: que fazes dos ventos teus mensageiros, dum fogo abrasador os teus ministros.
verses.en_web: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.
verses.en_bbe: He makes winds his angels, and flames of fire his servants.

verses.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.pt: Lançaste os fundamentos da terra, para que ela não fosse abalada em tempo algum.
verses.en_web: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
verses.en_bbe: He has made the earth strong on its bases, so that it may not be moved for ever and ever;

verses.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.pt: Tu a cobriste do abismo, como dum vestido; as águas estavam sobre as montanhas.
verses.en_web: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.en_bbe: Covering it with the sea as with a robe: the waters were high over the mountains;

verses.en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.pt: Â tua repreensão fugiram; à voz do teu trovão puseram-se em fuga.
verses.en_web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
verses.en_bbe: At the voice of your word they went in flight; at the sound of your thunder they went away in fear;

verses.en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.pt: Elevaram-se as montanhas, desceram os vales, até o lugar que lhes determinaste.
verses.en_web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
verses.en_bbe: The mountains came up and the valleys went down into the place which you had made ready for them.

verses.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.pt: Limite lhes traçaste, que não haviam de ultrapassar, para que não tornassem a cobrir a terra.
verses.en_web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
verses.en_bbe: You made a limit over which they might not go, so that the earth would never again be covered by them.

verses.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.pt: És tu que nos vales fazes rebentar nascentes, que correm entre as colinas.
verses.en_web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
verses.en_bbe: You sent the springs into the valleys; they are flowing between the hills.

verses.en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.pt: Dão de beber a todos os animais do campo; ali os asnos monteses matam a sua sede.
verses.en_web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.en_bbe: They give drink to every beast of the field; the mountain asses come to them for water.

verses.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.pt: Junto delas habitam as aves dos céus; dentre a ramagem fazem ouvir o seu canto.
verses.en_web: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
verses.en_bbe: The birds of the air have their resting-places by them, and make their song among the branches.

verses.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.pt: Da tua alta morada regas os montes; a terra se farta do fruto das tuas obras.
verses.en_web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
verses.en_bbe: He sends down rain from his store-houses on the hills: the earth is full of the fruit of his works.

verses.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.pt: Fazes crescer erva para os animais, e a verdura para uso do homem, de sorte que da terra tire o alimento,
verses.en_web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
verses.en_bbe: He makes the grass come up for the cattle, and plants for the use of man; so that bread may come out of the earth;

verses.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
verses.pt: o vinho que alegra o seu coração, o azeite que faz reluzir o seu rosto, e o pão que lhe fortalece o coração.
verses.en_web: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
verses.en_bbe: And wine to make glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face shining, and bread giving strength to his heart.

verses.en: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.pt: Saciam-se as árvores do Senhor, os cedros do Líbano que ele plantou,
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
verses.en_bbe: The trees of the Lord are full of growth, the cedars of Lebanon of his planting;

verses.en: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.pt: nos quais as aves se aninham, e a cegonha, cuja casa está nos ciprestes.
verses.en_web: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
verses.en_bbe: Where the birds have their resting-places; as for the stork, the tall trees are her house.

verses.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.pt: Os altos montes são um refúgio para as cabras montesas, e as rochas para os querogrilos.
verses.en_web: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.en_bbe: The high hills are a safe place for the mountain goats, and the rocks for the small beasts.

verses.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.pt: Designou a lua para marcar as estações; o sol sabe a hora do seu ocaso.
verses.en_web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
verses.en_bbe: He made the moon for a sign of the divisions of the year; teaching the sun the time of its going down.

verses.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.pt: Fazes as trevas, e vem a noite, na qual saem todos os animais da selva.
verses.en_web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
verses.en_bbe: When you make it dark, it is night, when all the beasts of the woods come quietly out of their secret places.

verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.pt: Os leões novos os animais bramam pela presa, e de Deus buscam o seu sustento.
verses.en_web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
verses.en_bbe: The young lions go thundering after their food; searching for their meat from God.

verses.en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.pt: Quando nasce o sol, logo se recolhem e se deitam nos seus covis.
verses.en_web: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.
verses.en_bbe: The sun comes up, and they come together, and go back to their secret places to take their rest.

verses.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.pt: Então sai o homem para a sua lida e para o seu trabalho, até a tarde.
verses.en_web: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: Man goes out to his work, and to his business, till the evening.

verses.en: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, quão multiformes são as tuas obras! Todas elas as fizeste com sabedoria; a terra está cheia das tuas riquezas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, how great is the number of your works! in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of the things you have made.

verses.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.pt: Eis também o vasto e espaçoso mar, no qual se movem seres inumeráveis, animais pequenos e grandes.
verses.en_web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
verses.en_bbe: There is the great, wide sea, where there are living things, great and small, more than may be numbered.

verses.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.pt: Ali andam os navios, e o leviatã que formaste para nele folgar.
verses.en_web: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
verses.en_bbe: There go the ships; there is that great beast, which you have made as a plaything.

verses.en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.pt: Todos esperam de ti que lhes dês o sustento a seu tempo.
verses.en_web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
verses.en_bbe: All of them are waiting for you, to give them their food in its time.

verses.en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.pt: Tu lho dás, e eles o recolhem; abres a tua mão, e eles se fartam de bens.
verses.en_web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
verses.en_bbe: They take what you give them; they are full of the good things which come from your open hand.

verses.en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.pt: Escondes o teu rosto, e ficam perturbados; se lhes tiras a respiração, morrem, e voltam para o seu pó.
verses.en_web: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.
verses.en_bbe: If your face is veiled, they are troubled; when you take away their breath, they come to an end, and go back to the dust.

verses.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.pt: Envias o teu fôlego, e são criados; e assim renovas a face da terra.
verses.en_web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
verses.en_bbe: If you send out your spirit, they are given life; you make new the face of the earth.

verses.en: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
verses.pt: Permaneça para sempre a glória do Senhor; regozije-se o Senhor nas suas obras;
verses.en_web: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
verses.en_bbe: Let the glory of the Lord be for ever; let the Lord have joy in his works:

verses.en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.pt: ele olha para a terra, e ela treme; ele toca nas montanhas, e elas fumegam.
verses.en_web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.en_bbe: At whose look the earth is shaking; at whose touch the mountains send out smoke.

verses.en: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.pt: Cantarei ao Senhor enquanto eu viver; cantarei louvores ao meu Deus enquanto eu existir.
verses.en_web: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.en_bbe: I will make songs to the Lord all my life; I will make melody to my God while I have my being.

verses.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
verses.pt: Seja-lhe agradável a minha meditação; eu me regozijarei no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let my thoughts be sweet to him: I will be glad in the Lord.

verses.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Sejam extirpados da terra os pecadores, e não subsistam mais os ímpios. Bendize, ó minha alma, ao Senhor. Louvai ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: Let sinners be cut off from the earth, and let all evil-doers come to an end. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. Give praise to the Lord.
